IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8
MODULE: WEB MATCH

PURPOSE
Analyze a supplied webpage, local site, screenshot or captured responsive state and reconstruct its visual system while preserving requested content/behavior.

ANALYZE
Viewport; breakpoints when evidence exists; grid; spacing; typography; colors; components; navigation; imagery; states; responsive relationships.

VERIFY
Render target viewport(s), compare to source/capture, correct geometry and styling, then regression-test functionality. Do not infer hidden responsive states as verified facts.
